name: Home Assistant
description: Control and automate everything in your home.
notes: Some devices are only found when Home Assistant uses the host network — edit /opt/homeassistant/docker-compose.yml if you need that.
compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable
    container_name: homeassistant
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8123"
    environment:
      TZ: "{TZ}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
